notes.notes: [p][b]Spinny Dungeon [/b]is a part of the [b]No Time To Loot Festival 2025[/b] on Steam! 🎉[/p][p]Download the demo and spin to SURVIVE![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3763910/Spinny_Dungeon_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45120639/83c37999c34557a7fbbf8bb6c945ea8d81bd51bb.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Demo is launched!
notes.notes: [p]The demo of Spinny Dungeon is now available! Finish the [b]FULL run[/b] with a Duelist![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3763910/Spinny_Dungeon_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]The game was balanced based on analytics added to the itch version. [b]446[/b] successful and [b]2400[/b] unsuccessful runs were analyzed. The popularity of the different symbols was distributed fairly evenly in the decks of winning players. A lot of builds are viable. The game is [b]hard[/b], but it's [b]fair[/b]. Don't forget to add Spinny Dungeon to your wishlist![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45120639/02966d85181266459af626c416c7e43f69e359e5.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Playtest on itch.io
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! Spinny Dungeon is on the final stages of development.
The [b]full Duelist run[/b] is now available on [b]itch.io[/b]. You can play directly in [b]your browser.[/b]

[url=https://typingmonkeystudio.itch.io/spinny-dungeon]https://typingmonkeystudio.itch.io/spinny-dungeon[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45120639/7934be5ccdf4b21668ccd7f95ab5da85dbf323cd.png[/img]
Game analytics were added to the game. So every choice you make during your runs helps to find underpowered and overpowered symbols/trinkets/spells.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45120639/ff007cac879617f511741dfe311c3f46dd0eb805.png[/img]

notes.title: Spinny Dungeon is an upcoming slot machine roguelite that might eat away your time
notes.notes:
While Spinny Dungeon won't suck away your money like a real slot machine, it will eat away your time.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2024/07/spinny-dungeon-is-an-upcoming-slot-machine-roguelite-that-might-eat-away-your-time
